title: Gearborn: Server Edition
description: This modpack is server side modpack for existing modpack Gearborn
body:
# Gearborn: Server Edition

**Gearborn: Server Edition** is a lightweight, server-optimized version of the [Gearborn](https://modrinth.com/modpack/gearborn) modpack — built around the Create mod and focused on mechanical creativity, immersive automation, and aesthetic engineering.

While this edition is **designed to run smoothly on servers**, it can also be used for **direct play as a minimal client**. It includes all gameplay-essential mods but skips client-side optimization mods like **sodium** to ensure maximum compatibility and server performance.

---

## ⚙️ Mechanical Survival, Multiplayer Ready

- ✅ **Server-Optimized**  
  Built without client-only mods (e.g., iris, sodium, etc) for maximum performance and stability in multiplayer environments.

---

## 🛠️ What's Included

This pack includes:
- Create + essential companion mods
- World and performance tweaks suited for multiplayer play
- No client-side performance mods (like sodium, shaders, or custom GUIs)
- Quality-of-life enhancements

---

## 👥 Ideal Use Cases

- Hosting a **dedicated multiplayer server** for Gearborn
- Keeping **performance high** while retaining Gearborn’s core mechanics

---

> Play smart. Host strong.  
> You were born for the gears — **Gearborn: Server Edition**.
